items.item_text: Current, valid California Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) or Clinical Immunohematologist Scientist (CIS) license.
Two years of recent CLS experience within a Blood Bank/Transfusion Medicine setting – preferred.
Experience with MTS gel methodology and solid-phase testing – preferred.
As a Clinical Laboratory Scientist specializing in Transfusion Medicine, you will be integral to our patient care team, undertaking the following duties:
Conduct patient transfusion testing and handle immunohematology problem work-ups.
Perform computer data entry and retrieval tasks.
Execute quality control testing and engage in quality assurance activities.
Provide essential transfusion support for a diverse range of patients, including those undergoing trauma and transplant procedures at UCLA Medical Center.
Record and review test results for accuracy and completeness while maintaining meticulous lab records.
Assist fellow patient care team members with inquiries regarding test results and blood product availability.
Must pass the Ishihara Color Vision exam, i.e. visual acuity including color differentiation.

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
